verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it exposes an API for building custom workflows. The project also ships an official go-sdk and the tea CLI, which are first-party programmatic ways to drive the product. However, the pack has no API reference documentation, and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the docs paths checked, so how well the API is documented is unproven. Missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, auth/endpoint coverage details, and independent hands-on reports of driving Gitea via its API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
